subject: Kickoff: LILA dense-feature service
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the LILA workstream. Our CVPR oral release learns dense visual representations from video using optical flow and monocular depth cues — no labels — and the released checkpoints (lila_dinov2_vits14 up through lila_dinov2_vitl14_kts) load straight from Torch Hub. Product thesis: a dense-feature service for the vision portfolio, so segmentation/depth teams stop training their own backbones per task.

Milestones:
- Apr 17: reproduce released evals on DAVIS, COCO-Stuff, and NYUv2 from the vitb14 checkpoint.
- Jun 12: retrained ViT-L on our own video corpus, matching released vitl14 quality.
- Jul 10: service API design review.

Bao owns staffing and the compute reservation — the June retraining is the big-ticket item. Csilla is research lead.

Lucia
